result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.count_selected_nodes()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get count of currently selected nodes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L6373-L6405){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.count_selected_nodes() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns the number of nodes currently marked as selected. More efficient than `len(get_selected_nodes())` when you only need the count. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Number of selected nodes. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Count selected nodes: ::: {#2131a869 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_full_graph(10) .select_nodes_by_degree(min_degree=5) ) count = graph.count_selected_nodes() # e.g., "10 high-degree nodes" f"{count} high-degree nodes" ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` '10 high-degree nodes' ``` ::: :::
